name: south-africa-claude-usage
title: How South Africans use Claude: Anthropic Economic Index, May 2026
description: Claude usage in South Africa, its four provinces with published figures and 26 African countries, from the Anthropic Economic Index (period 1 May 2026): the Anthropic Usage Index and rank, work, personal and coursework shares, augmentation and automation, and South Africa's top request topics, job categories and tasks against the world.
usageInfo: The Anthropic Economic Index data is released by Anthropic under CC BY 4.0 (code under MIT). These tables are a selection from it, reshaped by MzansiData. If you use them, credit "Anthropic Economic Index, Anthropic, CC BY 4.0" and MzansiData for the tables, and say if you changed them.

sources.title: Anthropic Economic Index (dataset metadata: publisher Anthropic, licence CC BY 4.0, latest period 2026-05-01, modified 2026-06-24)
sources.note: Read through the Anthropic Economic Index MCP tools (econ_index_*), not a downloaded file, so there is no file checksum. The same data is published at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Anthropic/EconomicIndex ("Data released under CC-BY, code released under MIT License").
